defaults._coverage_scope: measured on the ENGINE (qa_ledger.py) through the smoke run() choke point (~370 subprocess calls) AND, since 1.82.0 (D-03), on the auxiliary scripts (templates/scripts, mirador render) through the runpy() choke point -- each --source derived from the script own dirname because coverage.py --source is last-wins, not additive. Regenerate: USCHA_COVERAGE=1 bash uscha-kit/tests/smoke-engine.sh, then coverage combine && coverage xml --ignore-errors -o reports/coverage.xml (--ignore-errors is required: a golden-coverage capture leaves a sitecustomize.py from an already-deleted temp dir in the shared data file; without the flag coverage xml exits 1 and writes nothing). Under USCHA_COVERAGE=1 the suite reads two red criteria -- AC-GM-08 (COVERAGE_FILE overrides golden-coverage isolated data_file, pre-existing, see ISSUES-DEFERRED) and AC-06 which cascades from it; the plain suite is the gate.
